stationScope.evidence: The official Stadtwerke Rostock OSTSEE-STROM MOBIL page publishes 0.38 EUR/kWh at normal charging points and 0.48 EUR/kWh at fast charging points for eligible Stadtwerke Rostock electricity customers, with 4.99 EUR/month. Public direct-pay pages identify DE*HRO EVSEs as Stadtwerke Rostock, e.g. DE*HRO*E4220*02.

adHocDeferred.reason: Public m8mit direct-pay pages expose the exact EVSE and permit spontaneous charging, but no current universal numeric ad-hoc price is published in the official page text. Third-party discovery shows differing historical/current values, so no ad-hoc fallback is inferred.

blockingFeeDeferred.reason: The official page states that blocking fees are waived between 20:00 and 08:00 for the customer tariff but does not publish enough numeric trigger/cap detail in the retrieved current text to encode a complete rule without inference.

note: This is intentionally partial CPO coverage: the eligible customer contract is exact and operator-owned, while ad-hoc pricing remains fail-closed until a reproducible station/EVSE-level public price payload or official tariff table is available.
